allowedSideEffects.reason: axe-states captures the server-error state; with S04 on, that state renders a raw stack trace, typically in a <pre> with overflow:auto and no focusable content, which axe flags as scrollable-region-focusable (WCAG 2.1.1). The stack dump is the bug itself, so an extra axe finding on it is acceptable.

notes: Server errors render a stack trace in the page. verbose-errors must be able to trigger it with oversized/malformed input (Kennel must throw on that path, not only for pet name Crash). Considered and rejected: silent-failure (the error is still visible and announced, inputs kept).
